page_title: GEN 0-2 LAZ | Genoa v Lazio 23/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+2' A rebound falls kindly for Morten Frendrup (Genoa), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
90+1' Junior Messias (Genoa) sends a cross into the box, but Christos Mandas comes off his line to gather the ball.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Marco Baroni has decided to make a change. Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) replaces Mattia Zaccagni.
89' Substitution. Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Taty Castellanos walks off.
89' A clumsy foul by Junior Messias (Genoa) and Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle. A free kick to Lazio.
87' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
85' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) was quite harsh and Giovanni Ayroldi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
85' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Genoa.
84' The ball is cleared after Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.
80' Koni De Winter (Genoa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Giovanni Ayroldi had an easy-decision to make.
80' Patrick Vieira has decided to substitute Patrizio Masini and he is replaced by Jeff Ekhator (Genoa).
80' Substitution. Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) replaces Brooke Norton-Cuffy.
78' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Honest Ahanor (Genoa) sends it out of play.
74' Giovanni Ayroldi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Lorenzo Venturino (Genoa). There is a free kick near the sideline to Lazio.
73' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Reda Belahyane (Lazio). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.

72' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Reda Belahyane (Lazio), but referee Giovanni Ayroldi must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
71' The resulting set piece from Lazio is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Boulaye Dia trots off the pitch and is replaced by Matias Vecino (Lazio).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Reda Belahyane (Lazio) comes onto the pitch for Nicolo Rovella.
68' Patrick Vieira prepares a substitution. Andrea Pinamonti is replaced by Junior Messias (Genoa).
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Honest Ahanor (Genoa) comes onto the pitch so that Aaron Martin can be given a rest.
68' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
65' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Boulaye Dia (Lazio) receives a precise pass inside the box from Nicolo Rovella and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
63' Adam Marusic (Lazio) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
61' Patrick Vieira has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lorenzo Venturino (Genoa) replacing Vitinha.
61' Koni De Winter (Genoa) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the bottom left corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
61' Genoa get a corner.
60' Vitinha (Genoa) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. The referee signals a corner kick to Genoa.
59' Chance! Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Luca Pellegrini, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post.
57' Lazio have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
57' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Taty Castellanos (Lazio). The ball is out of play. Lazio win a corner kick.
51' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) sees a yellow card from Giovanni Ayroldi after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
48' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
47' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Giovanni Ayroldi blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Lazio in a dangerous position.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+9' Giovanni Ayroldi has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+9' The free kick is delivered by Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
45+8' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Lazio.
45+7' It looks like Boulaye Dia (Lazio) saw red with that tackle. Giovanni Ayroldi won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Genoa.
45+3' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
45+3' Aaron Martin (Genoa) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
45+3' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Aaron Martin (Genoa), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
45+2' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45' Problems for Marco Baroni as Manuel Lazzari is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Pedro (Lazio) replaces him.
45' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
45' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
44' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
42' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) receives a precise pass inside the box and fires the ball goalwards. His attempt is blocked by one of his teammates, though, and ricochets away off him.
41' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the right side of the goal, but Nicola Leali is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
40' Foul! Morten Frendrup (Genoa) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Lazio have been awarded a free kick.
38' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
35' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) makes sure he wins the cross from Manuel Lazzari near the penalty spot but is unable to get his header on target, sending it narrowly wide of the right post.

32' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Taty Castellanos (Lazio) scores with a brilliant shot into the top right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Luca Pellegrini. The score is now 0:1.
30' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the right post is saved by Nicola Leali.
30' The corner is swung in but Lazio can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
29' Aaron Martin (Genoa) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
27' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
27' A cross from a corner kick by Lazio is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
26' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Lazio win a corner.
26' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

26' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lazio will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
24' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Taty Castellanos (Lazio) on the edge of the box.
24' Lazio quickly take the free kick with a short pass.
24' A VAR review has confirmed the red card for Sebastian Otoa (Genoa).

23' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Sebastian Otoa (Genoa), but referee Giovanni Ayroldi must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
22' Sebastian Otoa (Genoa) makes a tackle on his opponent and is shown a harsh red card by the referee!
20' Christos Mandas (Lazio) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
17' Christos Mandas (Lazio) picks up an injury.

16' Aaron Martin (Genoa) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
15' Giovanni Ayroldi blows the whistle, Mario Gila (Lazio) is penalised for a foul. Genoa will take a free kick near the side line.
14' Christos Mandas pulls off a great save to deny Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
11' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Christos Mandas makes a save.
8' The linesman raises his flag. Taty Castellanos (Lazio) is adjudged offside.
6' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lazio comes to nothing.
6' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Taty Castellanos (Lazio), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Lazio have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the corner with a short pass.
5' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
4' The resulting corner from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is cleared.
3' Vitinha (Genoa) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Christos Mandas, who smothers the ball.
2' Aaron Martin (Genoa) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Genoa will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Giovanni Ayroldi.
